We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Autoplanner team, you will provide the critical software engineering capability that our data science and machine learning products rely on to reach production. • Evolve the team's mono-repo structure while actively delivering production services.

• Share in on-call and production support for mission-critical planning tools used by global partners.

• 5+ years of software engineering experience focusing on production Python services, ideally within data or ML-backed cloud systems.

• Expertise in modern, strongly typed Python.

• Extensive experience building data-intensive applications, ideally using event-driven architectures and analytical data stores such as BigQuery.

• Hands-on experience packaging, serving, and monitoring machine learning models in production.

• Proven experience delivering production async APIs, preferably with FastAPI.

• Strong cloud platform experience with AWS and/or GCP.

• Solid background in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines alongside a strong automated testing discipline.

• Proven software design skills, including system architecture and defining service boundaries, with a track record of close collaboration with data scientists.
